items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I met Joe Steele in church. His sister was my Sunday School teacher.

ctx.x: No. I met Joe Steele in church. His sister was my Sunday School teacher. I was going to Sunday School in them days, as a little boy. His mother... They were very religious people. Yeah, I met Joe in church.
Did you do any gigging with Joe Steele?
